description.text: The third Sword & Shield set, released on 14 August 2020 with 201 cards: 189 and 12 secret rares. The Legendary Eternatus arrives in it as a Pokémon V, beside Mew V, Centiskorch V and Galarian Slowbro V, and among its seven Pokémon VMAX are Charizard VMAX, Grimmsnarl VMAX and Butterfree VMAX in their Gigantamax forms.
